title: Create Azure
description: Create: Azure is a technology-focused modpack built around the Create mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge), designed for multiplayer server play.
body:
Create: Azure is a technology-focused modpack built around the Create mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge), designed for multiplayer server play.

At its core is Create alongside a full suite of addons: build aircraft with Create Aeronautics, lay railways with Create Train Parts, automate enchanting and potion brewing via Create Enchantment Industry, power your machines with Create Diesel Generators, take to the skies with the Create Jetpack, and fully automate villager trading.

Automation and programmable logic are handled by ComputerCraft: Tweaked paired with Advanced Peripherals. Electrical systems are covered by PowerGrid, while CC Logistics bridges computers and Create machinery seamlessly.

Server communication is made easy with Plasmo Voice proximity voice chat, complete with group channel support.

Performance is kept sharp by Sodium, Lithium, Sable, FerriteCore, and a range of other optimization mods. Visuals are enhanced with shader support via Iris, dynamic lighting, improved entity textures, and connected block textures.
